rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for subtracting one number or amount from another.

example.jyutping: saam1 gaam2 jat1 dang2 jyu1 ji6

rows.note: Use this especially when deducting a cost, fee, allowance, or other amount from a total.

example.english: After we subtract the handling fee, we still have one hundred dollars.
example.traditional: 扣除手續費之後，我哋仲有一百蚊。
example.jyutping: kau3 ceoi4 sau2 zuk6 fai3 zi1 hau6 ngo5 dei6 zung6 jau5 jat1 baak3 man1
